You are a general purpose agent that uses code to solve tasks.

You solve tasks by breaking down problems into sub-tasks, writing and executing code, observing results, and iterating one step at a time.

---

## Prime-Agent System Prompt (ACP Template)

For file editing operations, the prime-agent runtime exposes a pre-installed `mcp` Python object with `list_tools` and `call_tool` methods. Use them to discover and invoke tools.

Example discovery and call:

```python
tools_list = await mcp.list_tools("tools")
for t in tools_list:
    print(t["name"], t["inputSchema"])

result = await mcp.call_tool("tools", "ox-bridge-write", {"path": "/tmp/x.py", "content": "# code here"})
print(result)
```

The `tools` MCP server exposes:
- `ox-bridge-write`: write a file (args: `path`, `content`)
- `ox-bridge-edit`: edit a file with hunks (args: `path`, `edits` = [{old, new}])
- `ox-bridge-read`: read a file region (args: `path`, `start`, `end`)

All bridging calls return synchronously. Print results to confirm before proceeding.

Our frontend team needs a mock catalog API to develop against while the real service is still being built. Flask app with an in-memory list of 20 books (title, author, year, genre) and GET /books supporting ?author= (exact, case-insensitive), ?year_min=, ?year_max=, and ?genre=, all combinable. Invalid year values give 400 with a JSON error. Pytest with at least six cases including a combined filter and the 400; run until green.

"""Mock catalog API for frontend development.

Serves an in-memory list of books with filterable GET /books.
"""

from flask import Flask, jsonify, request

app = Flask(__name__)

BOOKS = [
    {"id": 1, "title": "The Hobbit", "author": "J.R.R. Tolkien", "year": 1937, "genre": "Fantasy"},
    {"id": 2, "title": "1984", "author": "George Orwell", "year": 1949, "genre": "Dystopian"},
    {"id": 3, "title": "Animal Farm", "author": "George Orwell", "year": 1945, "genre": "Satire"},
    {"id": 4, "title": "Dune", "author": "Frank Herbert", "year": 1965, "genre": "Science Fiction"},
    {"id": 5, "title": "Neuromancer", "author": "William Gibson", "year": 1984, "genre": "Cyberpunk"},
    {"id": 6, "title": "Pride and Prejudice", "author": "Jane Austen", "year": 1813, "genre": "Romance"},
    {"id": 7, "title": "Sense and Sensibility", "author": "Jane Austen", "year": 1811, "genre": "Romance"},
    {"id": 8, "title": "Emma", "author": "Jane Austen", "year": 1815, "genre": "Romance"},
    {"id": 9, "title": "The Great Gatsby", "author": "F. Scott Fitzgerald", "year": 1925, "genre": "Tragedy"},
    {"id": 10, "title": "To Kill a Mockingbird", "author": "Harper Lee", "year": 1960, "genre": "Southern Gothic"},
    {"id": 11, "title": "Brave New World", "author": "Aldous Huxley", "year": 1932, "genre": "Dystopian"},
    {"id": 12, "title": "Fahrenheit 451", "author": "Ray Bradbury", "year": 1953, "genre": "Dystopian"},
    {"id": 13, "title": "Frankenstein", "author": "Mary Shelley", "year": 1818, "genre": "Gothic"},
    {"id": 14, "title": "Dracula", "author": "Bram Stoker", "year": 1897, "genre": "Gothic"},
    {"id": 15, "title": "The Martian", "author": "Andy Weir", "year": 2011, "genre": "Science Fiction"},
    {"id": 16, "title": "Project Hail Mary", "author": "Andy Weir", "year": 2021, "genre": "Science Fiction"},
    {"id": 17, "title": "Foundation", "author": "Isaac Asimov", "year": 1951, "genre": "Science Fiction"},
    {"id": 18, "title": "I, Robot", "author": "Isaac Asimov", "year": 1950, "genre": "Science Fiction"},
    {"id": 19, "title": "The Catcher in the Rye", "author": "J.D. Salinger", "year": 1951, "genre": "Literary Fiction"},
    {"id": 20, "title": "Lord of the Flies", "author": "William Golding", "year": 1954, "genre": "Allegory"},
]


@app.get("/books")
def get_books():
    books = BOOKS

    author = request.args.get("author")
    if author is not None:
        wanted = author.lower()
        books = [b for b in books if b["author"].lower() == wanted]

    genre = request.args.get("genre")
    if genre is not None:
        books = [b for b in books if b["genre"] == genre]

    year_min_raw = request.args.get("year_min")
    year_max_raw = request.args.get("year_max")

    year_min = _parse_year(year_min_raw, "year_min")
    year_max = _parse_year(year_max_raw, "year_max")
    if year_min is not None:
        books = [b for b in books if b["year"] >= year_min]
    if year_max is not None:
        books = [b for b in books if b["year"] <= year_max]

    return jsonify({"count": len(books), "books": books})


def _parse_year(raw, param):
    """Parse a year query parameter; abort with 400 on invalid values."""
    if raw is None:
        return None
    try:
        return int(raw)
    except ValueError:
        response = jsonify({"error": f"Invalid value for '{param}': '{raw}' is not a valid year."})
        response.status_code = 400
        abort_with(response)


def abort_with(response):
    from flask import abort as _abort  # noqa: F401

    raise BadRequestResponse(response)


class BadRequestResponse(Exception):
    def __init__(self, response):
        self.response = response


@app.errorhandler(BadRequestResponse)
def _handle_bad_request(exc):
    return exc.response


if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(debug=True, port=5000)

import pytest

from app import app


@pytest.fixture()
def client():
    app.config["TESTING"] = True
    with app.test_client() as client:
        yield client


def test_all_books_without_filters(client):
    resp = client.get("/books")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    data = resp.get_json()
    assert data["count"] == 20
    assert len(data["books"]) == 20


def test_filter_author_exact_case_insensitive(client):
    resp = client.get("/books?author=GEORGE ORWELL")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    books = resp.get_json()["books"]
    assert {b["title"] for b in books} == {"1984", "Animal Farm"}
    assert all(b["author"] == "George Orwell" for b in books)


def test_filter_year_min_and_max(client):
    resp = client.get("/books?year_min=1950&year_max=1960")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    books = resp.get_json()["books"]
    assert all(1950 <= b["year"] <= 1960 for b in books)
    assert "Fahrenheit 451" in {b["title"] for b in books}
    assert "The Martian" not in {b["title"] for b in books}


def test_filter_genre(client):
    resp = client.get("/books?genre=Dystopian")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    books = resp.get_json()["books"]
    assert {b["title"] for b in books} == {"1984", "Brave New World", "Fahrenheit 451"}


def test_combined_filters(client):
    resp = client.get("/books?author=andy weir&genre=Science Fiction&year_min=2015&year_max=2025")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    data = resp.get_json()
    assert data["count"] == 1
    assert data["books"][0]["title"] == "Project Hail Mary"


def test_invalid_year_min_returns_400(client):
    resp = client.get("/books?year_min=abc")
    assert resp.status_code == 400
    body = resp.get_json()
    assert "error" in body
    assert "year_min" in body["error"]


def test_invalid_year_max_returns_400(client):
    resp = client.get("/books?year_max=19.5")
    assert resp.status_code == 400
    assert resp.is_json


def test_no_matches_returns_empty_list(client):
    resp = client.get("/books?author=Nobody Realname")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    data = resp.get_json()
    assert data["count"] == 0
    assert data["books"] == []
